question:
41. Fill in the blanks with appropriate preposition: [BWDB-EEE/ME-23]
(i) He fell ____ the roof of his house and has been in bed ____ the last two weeks.
(ii) I could not figure ____ what the teacher was talking ____.
(iii) As a sinner I must go ____ the whole trial ____ suffering.
(iv) I took ____ walking, hoping ____ lose some weight.
(v) I made ____ my mind ____ go there.
answer: (i) from, for; (ii) out, about; (iii) through, of; (iv) up, to; (v) up, to
explanation:
(i) He fell from the roof of his house and has been in bed for the last two weeks.
(ii) I could not figure out what the teacher was talking about.
(iii) As a sinner I must go through the whole trial of suffering.
(iv) I took up walking, hoping to lose some weight.
(v) I made up my mind to go there.
